description:
Give lease ids and worktree ids their own validated types in lease records and the claim coordinator.

## Background

Lease ids are generated as `Uuid::new_v4().to_string()` (`crates/jit/src/storage/claim_coordinator.rs:479,612,774`) and stored as `Lease.lease_id: String` (`:33`); worktree ids are `Lease.worktree_id: String` (`:39`) and `WorktreeIdentity.worktree_id` (`storage/worktree_identity.rs:24`). Two fallbacks produce worktree ids outside the `wt:<hex>` form: `commands/worktree.rs:282` (`wt:{branch}`) and `commands/mod.rs:731` (the worktree root path). `commands/worktree.rs:19,34,144` carry worktree ids as `String` fields and parameters.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `domain::identity::LeaseId` accepts canonical UUIDs, and `domain::identity::WorktreeId` accepts non-empty tokens without whitespace. Both serialize as plain strings.
- [hard] REQ-02: `Lease`, `ClaimOp`, `ClaimCoordinator` and `WorktreeIdentity` hold `LeaseId` and `WorktreeId`.
- [hard] REQ-03: Both fallback producers construct a `WorktreeId`, and a fallback source that is not a valid token yields an error naming it.
- [hard] REQ-04: Lease-id CLI arguments are parsed once into `LeaseId` at the boundary.
- [hard] REQ-05: No field or parameter in `commands/worktree.rs`, `storage/worktree_identity.rs` or `storage/claim_coordinator.rs` holds a lease or worktree id as `String` or `&str`.
- [hard] REQ-06: Lease fixtures in tests use canonical lease ids, including the `claims.index.json` fixtures of `crates/jit/tests/cli_item_validate/validation_lease_tests.rs`.

## Notes

Removing the fallbacks was rejected as a behaviour change outside this scope. Lease-sequence restructuring is out of scope; only fields and constructors change.
title: Lease and worktree ids are dedicated types
